scripts.db:migrar:local: pnpm --filter @adnh-fc/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply adnh-fc-db --local
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --filter @adnh-fc/api exec wrangler d1 execute adnh-fc-db --local --file=../../seeds/dev.sql
scripts.db:migrar:remoto: pnpm --filter @adnh-fc/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply adnh-fc-db --remote
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @adnh-fc/web build && pnpm --filter @adnh-fc/api exec wrangler deploy
